Lesson 13.4 · 24 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Controls, roles and evidence requirements

After this lesson you can:
  • Turn an obligation into preventive and detective controls
  • Specify segregation and authority
  • Define evidence and operating-effectiveness tests
On this page
  1. Control statement
  2. Authority
  3. Evidence quality
  4. Where this lives in LoanOS
  5. Knowledge check

1. Control statement

Write objective, risk, trigger, rule, owner, performer, approver, frequency, exception route and retained evidence. Decide whether preventive, detective or corrective and whether manual, automated or hybrid.

2. Authority

Map role plus scope, amount/product thresholds, conflicts, step-up authentication, delegation and expiry. Maker-checker means independence is enforced against identity and action history, not two button labels.

3. Evidence quality

Evidence identifies tenant, actor, time, input versions, decision, before/after state and integrity.

Design both implementation test and operating-effectiveness sample.

A policy document without observed execution is design evidence only.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-IT-GRC — Requirements, change and test evidence must support controlled, auditable processing.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability SEC-005 — Scoped RBAC and segregation.
  • Capability LWS-002 — Maker-checker.
  • Capability AUD-003 — Audit verification.
  • Capability REG-008 — Waiver governance.

Key terms

Maker-checker Evidence pack Tenant

Knowledge check

1. What proves maker-checker operating effectiveness?

  1. A policy document
  2. Sampled executions showing independent identities, authority and immutable approval evidence
  3. Two buttons
  4. A training record alone
Show answer

B. Operating evidence must show the control actually executed as designed.
